import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from validation.core.config_loader import ConfigLoader


class TestConfigLoader(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.datasets_path = Path("config/datasets.yaml")
        self.rubrics_dir = Path("config/rubrics")
        self.loader = ConfigLoader(self.datasets_path, self.rubrics_dir)

    def test_load_dataset(self) -> None:
        cfg = self.loader.get_dataset("intent_v1")
        self.assertEqual(cfg.task_type, "intent")
        self.assertIn("rubric_llm", cfg.validators)
        self.assertEqual(cfg.judge_persona, "strict_intent")

    def test_load_rubric(self) -> None:
        rubric = self.loader.get_rubric("qa")
        self.assertEqual(rubric.task_type, "qa")
        self.assertIn("correctness", rubric.dimensions)
        self.assertGreater(rubric.thresholds.keep_min, rubric.thresholds.review_min)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Config loader for datasets and rubrics."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import yaml

from validation.core.rubrics import DatasetDecisionPolicy, RubricConfig


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetConfig:
    name: str
    task_type: str
    validators: list[str]
    batch_size: int
    jury_score_band: Optional[tuple[float, float]]
    decision_policy: DatasetDecisionPolicy
    judge_persona: Optional[str] = None
    jury_personas: Optional[list[str]] = None


class ConfigLoader:
    """Loads dataset configs and task rubrics from YAML."""

    def __init__(self, datasets_path: Path, rubrics_dir: Path):
        self.datasets_path = datasets_path
        self.rubrics_dir = rubrics_dir

    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def get_dataset(self, dataset_name: str) -> DatasetConfig:
        data = yaml.safe_load(self.datasets_path.read_text())
        datasets = data.get("datasets", {})
        if dataset_name not in datasets:
            raise KeyError(f"dataset {dataset_name} not found in {self.datasets_path}")
        cfg: Dict[str, Any] = datasets[dataset_name]
        policy = cfg.get("decision_policy", {})
        jury_band = cfg.get("jury_score_band")
        return DatasetConfig(
            name=dataset_name,
            task_type=cfg.get("task_type", "generic"),
            validators=cfg.get("validators", []),
            batch_size=int(cfg.get("batch_size", 256)),
            jury_score_band=tuple(jury_band) if jury_band else None,
            decision_policy=DatasetDecisionPolicy(
                min_keep_score=float(policy.get("min_keep_score", policy.get("keep_min", 3.8))),
                min_review_score=float(policy.get("min_review_score", policy.get("review_min", 3.0))),
                disagreement_low=float(policy.get("disagreement_low", 0.5)),
                disagreement_high=float(policy.get("disagreement_high", 1.5)),
            ),
            judge_persona=cfg.get("judge_persona"),
            jury_personas=cfg.get("jury_personas"),
        )

    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def get_rubric(self, task_type: str) -> RubricConfig:
        path = self.rubrics_dir / f"{task_type}.yaml"
        if not path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"rubric for task_type {task_type} not found at {path}")
        return RubricConfig.from_file(path)

"""Rubric models and loader."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping

import yaml
from pydantic import BaseModel, validator


class RubricDimension(BaseModel):
    weight: float
    description: str = ""


class RubricThresholds(BaseModel):
    keep_min: float
    review_min: float

    @validator("keep_min")
    def _keep_min_ge_review(cls, v, values):
        review_min = values.get("review_min", 0.0)
        if v < review_min:
            raise ValueError("keep_min must be >= review_min")
        return v


class RubricConfig(BaseModel):
    task_type: str
    dimensions: Dict[str, RubricDimension]
    scoring: Dict[str, Any]
    thresholds: RubricThresholds
    scale_min: float
    scale_max: float

    @validator("scale_max")
    def _scale_max_gt_min(cls, v, values):
        if v <= values.get("scale_min", 0):
            raise ValueError("scale_max must be greater than scale_min")
        return v

    @classmethod
    def from_file(cls, path: Path) -> "RubricConfig":
        data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text())
        scoring = data.get("scoring", {})
        thresholds = scoring.get("thresholds", {})
        return cls(
            task_type=data["task_type"],
            dimensions=data["dimensions"],
            scoring=scoring,
            thresholds=RubricThresholds(
                keep_min=thresholds.get("keep_min", scoring.get("keep_min", 0)),
                review_min=thresholds.get("review_min", scoring.get("review_min", 0)),
            ),
            scale_min=scoring.get("scale_min", scoring.get("scale_minimum", 0)),
            scale_max=scoring.get("scale_max", scoring.get("scale_maximum", 5)),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DatasetDecisionPolicy:
    min_keep_score: float
    min_review_score: float
    disagreement_low: float = 0.5
    disagreement_high: float = 1.5


__all__ = ["RubricConfig", "RubricDimension", "RubricThresholds", "DatasetDecisionPolicy"]
